name: Platelayer
author: E. T. Carter
description: A deep-level tube tunnel from the cab of a slow train: dim headlights rake solid concrete sleepers bedded in matte ballast, with two running rails and a centre conductor rail standing proud on baseplates, their polished heads catching the light, while chipped rib arches, sagging cable runs, caged bulkheads and hooded signal heads slide past toward a bend right of centre.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: How fast the train runs, sliding sleepers, ribs and signals past.

params.label: Bend
params.effect: How hard the tunnel curves away to the right, from a straight bore to a tight bend.

params.label: Lamps
params.effect: Brightness of the signal heads and caged bulkheads and the light they pool on walls and track.

params.label: Headlights
params.effect: Strength of the train headlights raking the sleepers and rails ahead.
